name: Dubai
notes: Dubai: the city series is Property Monitor's Dynamic Price Index (a private index of DLD-registered residential sales, January 2008 = 100), taken at the last month of each quarter, 2008Q1 to 2026Q3. For comparison, the Dubai Land Department's official indices: the current residential index (general, flats, villas; quarterly from 2020) and the older Residential Sales Price Index (January 2012 = 1, all, flats, villas; 2011 to 2022, discontinued). The two DLD indices are not linked by DLD and are shown separately. No community-level series is published free. Both publishers' terms limit reuse to personal, non-commercial viewing.
